title: Integrate rigid two-way couplings into the single-step solve
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Move existing rigid-cloth, rigid-soft, rigid-rope and rigid-smoke coupling operators to the new same-epoch schedule; rigid-liquid belongs to F8-18. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Registered modes execute once per tick with bounded inner algebraic work, one spatial snapshot and no double integration of endpoints.
Test balanced exchanges, thin containment, fast/mass-ratio cases, lifecycle/rebinding and three-plus-family ordering against F8-03 independent cases.
Document splitting/accuracy losses within F8-00; prove per-operator dispatch budgets and no per-edge BVH rebuild.
Do not enable previously unsupported coupling modes; keep old/new profile capability and qualification records separate.

history.reason: Added bounded same-epoch rigid-cloth, rigid-soft, rigid-rope and rigid-smoke exchanges with physical CUDA quality, lifecycle, ordering and work-budget evidence; legacy profile remains separate.
